name: Kunoichi Asuka ~Yoshiwara Yuukaku Kidan~
original_name: くのいち飛鳥～吉原遊郭奇談～
source:
Some dead bodies are found in Yoshiwara, a red-light district. The victims are a son of a high official and his surroundings. Asuka, a Kunoichi (female ninja), is sent to Yoshiwara to investigate the case. As she investigates it, the situation goes chaotic. She is also attacked by another Kunoichi and gets involved in a different case....

[From ErogeShop]
